title: Graph theoretic derivation of mutual linearity for transient probabilities and hitting time distributions in Markov networks
summary: For irreducible, time-homogeneous Markov networks, mutual linearity has recently been established for both occupation probabilities and network currents in the stationary regime as well as in the non-stationary regime in Laplace space. The derivation of this property for the stationary distribution utilized the Markov chain tree theorem, which also allows for an explicit combinatorial expression of the response ratios under variation of a single transition rate.
